data.one_liner: Provides an iOS-style onboarding experience with Flutter widgets.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to create iOS-inspired onboarding screens and 'What's New' feature showcases. It provides customizable pages with support for icons, titles, bodies, and feature lists.
use_when: You want to build an iOS-style onboarding flow for your Flutter app.
You need to showcase new app features in a native Apple-like modal or screen.
avoid_when: You require a strictly Material Design onboarding experience.
You are building a complex multi-step form wizard rather than a feature showcase.
strengths: Provides a native Cupertino look and feel out of the box.
Supports light and dark mode automatically.
Minimal code required to set up onboarding pages and features.
weaknesses: Relies on external packages like modal_bottom_sheet for full native modal feel.
